tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. DEPRECATED: Use read_text_file instead.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Both source and destination must be within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access.
